clusters.name: After Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Bea was born in March 1995, a third child ten years after you. Within months, your mother was worn out and on edge with the baby, your parents began working late and avoiding open communication, you developed stomach aches and missed school, your brother and father had shouting matches, and your mother's functioning fell as she did not return to her job. Five shifts that count piled up over the year following the birth of a sibling to this close family.
